author: marici.Strominger

checks.statement: for g>=3 the q=3 source rows give a triangular base block
checks.detail: rows=(0,3,-g-2,1-g,-g-4,-g-1); all off-diagonal entries lie left of pivots

checks.statement: the preferred q=3 determinant is the six-endpoint product
the preferred chart is nonzero for every integer g>=3
checks.detail: only admissible preferred factor zero is g=2

checks.statement: the symbolic product equals all regular generated base minors
the grade-two pivot zero is repaired by a nonzero two-row chart
the q=3 base block is full rank at every grade g>=2
checks.detail: g=2 alternate chart plus symbolic preferred chart for g>=3

verdict: For g>=3 the q=3 initialization block is support-triangular with determinant 8g(g-2)(g+4)(g+6)(2 rising g)^2(4 rising g)^4. Its sole preferred pivot zero is g=2, where a two-row alternate chart has local determinant -2400 and the full block remains invertible. Thus q=3 has no initialization kernel; the apparent grade-two zero is a presentation boundary.
